visual_instruction: Replace black suspenders with red ones.
frame_definition: Actual post-step sampler state: committed token cells are decoded; currently masked cells are opaque gray
aggregation: Equal weight per image; mean over each image's region tokens, then image mean; SEM across images
entropy_definition: -sum_v p_t(v) log p_t(v), in nats; p_t is float32 softmax of full-grid post-CFG logits before scheduler freezing
stability_definition: mean_i 1[argmax_v p_t(v|i) != argmax_v p_T(v|i)] within each fixed mask partition; final-step reference, not ground truth
commitment_definition: First decoding step after which the sampler leaves a token unmasked; a sampling decision, not an independent uncertainty measurement

protocol.negative_prompt: worst quality, low quality, low res, blurry, distortion, watermark, logo, signature, text, jpeg artifacts, signature, sketch, duplicate, ugly, identifying mark
protocol.entropy: float32 post-CFG full-grid logits; natural logarithm; all positions
protocol.stability: raw per-step argmax disagreement with final-forward raw argmax
protocol.frame_type: scheduler prev_sample; uncommitted mask-token cells shown in solid gray
protocol.image_preprocessing: source and annotation square-resized together before native preprocessing
